envVars.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: Workers secret used to sign sessions. Required: auth throws while the Worker initializes when it is unset, unless BETTER_AUTH_URL names a loopback host.
envVars.BETTER_AUTH_URL:
The API's own origin (e.g. https://api.x.com, or http://localhost:4000 locally). Used as the auth baseURL, to derive the cookie domain, and to allow the keyless local dev loop. When unset there is no loopback exception, so BETTER_AUTH_SECRET becomes mandatory, and the session cookie stays host-only unless COOKIE_DOMAIN sets it.
FIRST USER WINS: the first account to sign up on an empty user table gets role 'admin'. Sign-up is open, so once this origin is public anyone who reaches /signup before you becomes the admin. Sign up yourself as soon as the API answers. Run /saasaloy-auth for the recovery SQL if somebody else got there first.
envVars.COOKIE_DOMAIN: Optional. Explicit cookie domain (e.g. .x.com) for cross-subdomain sessions. Derived from BETTER_AUTH_URL when unset.
